label: boundary adoption (docs/design/boundary-adoption-2026-10-23): v1 with model.classify v2, which takes node 11's host-checked interval as a second ordered ref in JSON value form; the acceptance limits are stored once here
goal_template: Prepare an evidence-limited inspection handoff. The numerical acceptance interval is [{lower},{upper}] mm, inclusive. Interval inclusion is arithmetic only, not physical validation.
goal: Prepare an evidence-limited inspection handoff. The numerical acceptance interval is [12.48,12.52] mm, inclusive. Interval inclusion is arithmetic only, not physical validation.
instruction_source: extract and bounds: v1 unchanged; classify: Opus round 1 section 3 text as signed by Astra in round 2 (probe arm C with the goal limits as L and U, no recomputation clause)

model.extract.name: extract
model.extract.instruction: Return a compact JSON array of strings containing the ref's length, uncertainty, n, method, basis, physical_validation, in that order, preserving field values exactly.

model.bounds.name: bounds
model.bounds.instruction: Return a compact JSON array [length-uncertainty,length+uncertainty], each formatted as a string with two decimal places and unit mm. If uncertainty is unknown, return unknown.

model.classify.name: classify
model.classify.instruction: The first ref is the measurement record. The second ref is its host-checked interval: [lower,upper], or unknown. If the interval is unknown, return unknown. Otherwise use its endpoints directly. Let L and U be the lower and upper limits of the goal's acceptance interval, in mm. Return inside if lower >= L AND upper <= U; outside otherwise. Equality at either limit is inside.

stale.note: after node 11 commits and before classification dispatch: A length 12.50 mm -> 12.55 mm

bump.note: same hook; identical bytes, new authoritative revision

packets.note: size-4 stages are an experimental composition with oracle proof; the two-ref classify cells at sizes 4 and 1 are qualified separately (qual.json) before the suite runs

reruns.note: no reruns: a failure ends this adoption attempt
